# GridFall GDScript API

Generated from the `##` doc comments in `scripts/`. Regenerate with `python3 tools/gen_api_docs.py`; CI fails when this folder is stale.

## [scripts/](scripts.md)

- [audio_director.gd](scripts.md#scriptsaudio_directorgd) (`GridFallAudioDirector`): Dynamic ACE-Step 1.5 soundtrack crossfader & crisis SFX director
- [cinematic.gd](scripts.md#scriptscinematicgd) (`Cinematic`): Scripted ~30 s trailer for social posts
- [episode_player.gd](scripts.md#scriptsepisode_playergd) (`GridFallEpisodePlayer`): Loads and plays multi-model GMI Cloud crisis episodes (episodes/crisis_blackout_01.json)
- [main.gd](scripts.md#scriptsmaingd): GridFall: a SimCity-style city run by five autonomous GMI Cloud AI mayors
- [save_slot.gd](scripts.md#scriptssave_slotgd) (`SaveSlot`): One saved city on disk, written so a crash or a full disk mid-save never costs the player their city: the new save goes to <path>.tmp first, the previous one moves to <path>.bak, and only then does the new file take the slot's name

## [scripts/ai/](scripts.ai.md)

- [action_clean.gd](scripts.ai.md#scriptsaiaction_cleangd) (`ActionClean`): A model's order (one entry of "actions") made safe to show and to apply
- [arena_ask.gd](scripts.ai.md#scriptsaiarena_askgd) (`ArenaAsk`): "Ask the five": the overseer asks one question and the five mayors' models answer it in parallel, each from the same city state it would plan a normal turn from (CityBrain's own mayor prompts) with the question appended as "OVERSEER QUESTION"
- [brain_calls.gd](scripts.ai.md#scriptsaibrain_callsgd): The GMI calls a CityBrain has in flight, and which city each was sent for (CityBrain extends this)
- [brain_text.gd](scripts.ai.md#scriptsaibrain_textgd): Removes model brand names from CityBrain text: a Gazette page as it comes in, and state restored from saves written before the display names, whose text feeds the prompts and the HUDs
- [chatter_minds.gd](scripts.ai.md#scriptsaichatter_mindsgd) (`ChatterMinds`): The voices of the global chat and of face-to-face talk (slice C §3)
- [city_brain.gd](scripts.ai.md#scriptsaicity_braingd) (`CityBrain`): Puts GMI model inference on every layer of the city
- [council_log.gd](scripts.ai.md#scriptsaicouncil_loggd): The council vote board's data: what the Speaker did with each proposal and how the five mayors had voted
- [gmi_admission.gd](scripts.ai.md#scriptsaigmi_admissiongd) (`GmiAdmission`): How many live calls GmiClient has out at once, with the mayors first
- [gmi_breakers.gd](scripts.ai.md#scriptsaigmi_breakersgd) (`GmiBreakers`): The circuit breakers of GmiClient, one per group of roles
- [gmi_cache.gd](scripts.ai.md#scriptsaigmi_cachegd) (`GmiCache`): The shape of GmiClient's answer caches: {key: [{day, data}, ...]}
- [gmi_client.gd](scripts.ai.md#scriptsaigmi_clientgd) (`GmiClient`): Async GMI Cloud chat client with JSON extraction, a recorded replay cache, and heuristic fallback
- [gmi_image_client.gd](scripts.ai.md#scriptsaigmi_image_clientgd) (`GmiImageClient`): Async poster image client for GMI's hy-image-v3.5-preview (slice D)
- [gmi_parse.gd](scripts.ai.md#scriptsaigmi_parsegd) (`GmiParse`): Reads the JSON object a model put in its reply
- [gmi_preflight.gd](scripts.ai.md#scriptsaigmi_preflightgd) (`GmiPreflight`): The readiness check of a key (flag gmi_preflight): once per key, one GET of the model list through GmiClient (its own _models_trip, so no request leaves the process any other way), compared with the model ids the game calls (GmiReadiness), a sentence for the key panel and one line in the GMI log
- [gmi_readiness.gd](scripts.ai.md#scriptsaigmi_readinessgd) (`GmiReadiness`): "Which of the 14 models does this key reach?" Pure helpers for GmiClient.preflight.run(): the list of model ids the game is configured to call (mayors, support agents, the resident and chatter pools), the ids a GET /v1/models reply names, their comparison, and the sentence the key panel shows
- [gmi_reply.gd](scripts.ai.md#scriptsaigmi_replygd) (`GmiReply`): Reads one chat-completion body into what the game keeps of it: the answer object, the text it came from, which repairs the reply needed, and what the API reported about its size
- [mayor_context.gd](scripts.ai.md#scriptsaimayor_contextgd): Mayor context v2 (flag mayor_context_v2, default off until it has been tried live): what lets the five models answer EACH OTHER instead of five separate cities
- [mayor_prompts.gd](scripts.ai.md#scriptsaimayor_promptsgd): The mayors' turn prompts, moved out of CityBrain (which keeps thin wrappers)
- [mayor_turns.gd](scripts.ai.md#scriptsaimayor_turnsgd): Staggered mayor turns (CityBrain.stagger_mayors, on in street mode)
- [model_ledger.gd](scripts.ai.md#scriptsaimodel_ledgergd) (`ModelLedger`): What each model has done in this city: calls, how many answered live, failed, fell back to a recorded answer or to the scripted planner, how long they took to answer, which errors they got, which repairs their replies needed, how many tokens they used and, for the mayors, how many of their orders the city accepted
- [resident_minds.gd](scripts.ai.md#scriptsairesident_mindsgd) (`ResidentMinds`): Gives every resident a GMI brain
- [road_plans.gd](scripts.ai.md#scriptsairoad_plansgd): The heuristic mayor's road orders (CityBrain._heuristic_mayor): new roads to open land, at as cheap a grade as the funds call for, and paving rough roads that lots have grown along

## [scripts/fp/](scripts.fp.md)

- [asset_paths.gd](scripts.fp.md#scriptsfpasset_pathsgd): First-person asset paths
- [body_contacts.gd](scripts.fp.md#scriptsfpbody_contactsgd): Contacts of a box body on the ground plane (a car) with the walker's world: CollisionWorld's boxes and cylinders that reach above the body's step and start below its roof, and ground it cannot drive onto (water and the bridge parapets, where walk_height is NAN, or a rise above WS.STEP_HEIGHT)
- [city_directory.gd](scripts.fp.md#scriptsfpcity_directorygd) (`CityDirectory`): Human place names for the city: streets for road runs, addresses for lots, business and landmark names, district names
- [first_day.gd](scripts.fp.md#scriptsfpfirst_daygd): The first-day opening (flag first_day_opening): what a fresh street city does differently on its day 1, so the first minute shows a bright morning, a view down the avenue and a mayor turn soon
- [forest_trees.gd](scripts.fp.md#scriptsfpforest_treesgd): The woods' synthetic trees
- [fp_context.gd](scripts.fp.md#scriptsfpfp_contextgd) (`FpContext`): Service locator for first-person slices
- [fp_feature.gd](scripts.fp.md#scriptsfpfp_featuregd) (`FpFeature`): A first-person feature module owned by one slice
- [fp_features.gd](scripts.fp.md#scriptsfpfp_featuresgd): Every first-person feature, in setup order
- [fp_mode.gd](scripts.fp.md#scriptsfpfp_modegd) (`FpMode`): First-person composition root: builds the context, bus, player, collision, HUD and every registered feature, owns time controls, pause, the mouse and the FP save section
- [game_bus.gd](scripts.fp.md#scriptsfpgame_busgd) (`GameBus`): Signals that cross first-person slices
- [obb2d.gd](scripts.fp.md#scriptsfpobb2dgd): Oriented boxes and circles on the ground plane, as Vector2(x, z): overlap tests, contacts and inertia for the player's car body and the street props it knocks over
- [road_topology.gd](scripts.fp.md#scriptsfproad_topologygd) (`RoadTopology`): Static road-tile helpers shared by collision, traffic, the directory, the minimap and the streetscape
- [scene_loads.gd](scripts.fp.md#scriptsfpscene_loadsgd): PackedScenes loaded on background threads (ResourceLoader's threaded loads), for the features that stream bodies in (the crews' workers, the dogs): request() starts a load, scene() hands the scene out once it is in, and finish() waits for the loads still in flight
- [world_scale.gd](scripts.fp.md#scriptsfpworld_scalegd): First-person world scale

## [scripts/fp/actions/](scripts.fp.actions.md)

- [actions_feature.gd](scripts.fp.actions.md#scriptsfpactionsactions_featuregd): Body actions (integration slice; docs/fp/ARCHITECTURE.md, Body actions): the hero's fists and gestures on foot

## [scripts/fp/activity/](scripts.fp.activity.md)

- [activity_beacons.gd](scripts.fp.activity.md#scriptsfpactivityactivity_beaconsgd): World beacons for the AI activity layer: one per agent key ("mayor:1", "council", "chaos"), a tall light column in the agent's colour over the tile its latest decision touched, with a ring on the ground that pulses while the decision is new and dims once it is old
- [activity_feature.gd](scripts.fp.activity.md#scriptsfpactivityactivity_featuregd): AI activity (integration feature "activity"): the city's AI decisions, visible from the street
- [activity_feed.gd](scripts.fp.activity.md#scriptsfpactivityactivity_feedgd): The AI activity feed (feature "activity"), top right under the compass: a header with the key and whether the city's agents answer live, a line for who is deciding now (or who goes next), then the newest decisions as cards
- [activity_press.gd](scripts.fp.activity.md#scriptsfpactivityactivity_pressgd): The press run: a campaign poster that a live image model made lands on the street (GameBus poster_ready with meta.source "live"), and the activity feed says so with the image model's badge and the mayor whose campaign it is
- [activity_tags.gd](scripts.fp.activity.md#scriptsfpactivityactivity_tagsgd): Floating tags over the AI beacons (feature "activity"): for each beacon in front of the camera and within RANGE, who decided and what, with the distance, pinned above the ground at the beacon (lower when near, so a close beacon's tag stays in view)
- [activity_words.gd](scripts.fp.activity.md#scriptsfpactivityactivity_wordsgd): Plain words for the AI activity layer: what a mayor's turn did ("Zoned 6 homes · Ordered a Solar Farm"), council, chaos and grid rulings, a support agent's model badge, where an answer came from (live, replay or offline), "4 min" ages and compass directions

## [scripts/fp/animals/](scripts.fp.animals.md)

- [animal_caps.gd](scripts.fp.animals.md#scriptsfpanimalsanimal_capsgd): The web tier's animals density cap (quality.gd WEB_DENSITY "animals", flag web_quality) split over the animals feature's groups, and its application to the feature
- [animal_math.gd](scripts.fp.animals.md#scriptsfpanimalsanimal_mathgd): The flat-world helpers the animals modules work in (u, y up): a tile's ground position, flat distance, the strike cone's gap and the pick ray's ball hit
- [animals_feature.gd](scripts.fp.animals.md#scriptsfpanimalsanimals_featuregd): Dogs, pigeons, cats and squirrels in the street (integration feature "animals")
- [bird_flocks.gd](scripts.fp.animals.md#scriptsfpanimalsbird_flocksgd): The flock nodes' shared half, used by the pigeons' two nodes (pigeons.gd's foraging flocks and perches.gd's perched ones): the pigeon_flock.gd list each drives, the world the animals feature feeds it from the dogs' pack before every step (world()), the step loop and the draw (step_flocks(), _draw()), the MultiMesh each flock draws with (pigeon_body.gd's bird, one instance and tint a bird) and the tile spots the node's own _spot_of() finds (scan_flocks() brings the near ones out, the nearest first, within its cap)
- [cat_bodies.gd](scripts.fp.animals.md#scriptsfpanimalscat_bodiesgd): The cats' bodies: Quaternius' Cat (AP.CAT, built by tools/blender/make_cat.py), loaded, pooled and scaled as the dogs' bodies are (dog_bodies.gd), with a CatRig on the skeleton for the tail and the head and the coat shader (cat_coat.gdshader) on the body; dress() gives a body its coat
- [cat_life.gd](scripts.fp.animals.md#scriptsfpanimalscat_lifegd): The cats' behaviour; cats.gd decides where cats keep and feeds in the world before every step()
- [cat_rig.gd](scripts.fp.animals.md#scriptsfpanimalscat_riggd): A cat's life on top of its clip (CatBodies puts one on every cat skeleton): the tail sways from the tip (wag 0..1, from a lazy sway to the lashing of a hunter or an angry cat) and droops back from the clip's carriage (droop 0..1; the clips stand it up, a frightened cat's hangs low); the head turns toward look and lifts with each meow (bark) as a dog's does
- [cats.gd](scripts.fp.animals.md#scriptsfpanimalscatsgd): The cats (part of the animals feature): where cats keep, coming out within NEAR of the player and going beyond FAR; the world fed to their behaviour (cat_life.gd) before every step; their bodies (cat_bodies.gd) in their coats; and E to pet one close by
- [dog_bodies.gd](scripts.fp.animals.md#scriptsfpanimalsdog_bodiesgd): The dogs' bodies: Quaternius' Shiba Inu and Husky (AP.DOG_SHIBA, AP.DOG_HUSKY), each scene under a root scaled from model units to its breed's height at the shoulder, with the scene's own AnimationPlayer playing the clips in place (the dog pack moves the root) and a DogRig on the skeleton for the tail, the head and the barks
- [dog_leads.gd](scripts.fp.animals.md#scriptsfpanimalsdog_leadsgd): The leads from owners' hands to their dogs' collars: one camera-facing ribbon each, sagging with the slack, redrawn every frame into a single ImmediateMesh (draw())
- [dog_pack.gd](scripts.fp.animals.md#scriptsfpanimalsdog_packgd): The dogs' behaviour; the animals feature decides who has a dog and feeds in the world before every step()
- [dog_rig.gd](scripts.fp.animals.md#scriptsfpanimalsdog_riggd): A dog's life on top of its clip (DogBodies puts one on every dog skeleton): the tail wags (wag 0..1, faster as it grows), the head turns and tilts toward a world point (look) and jerks up with each bark (bark 1, easing back to 0 here)
- [duck_body.gd](scripts.fp.animals.md#scriptsfpanimalsduck_bodygd): The duck every duck MultiMesh draws: one ArrayMesh built in code (metres, facing +Z, the soles at the origin) and its ShaderMaterial (duck.gdshader spreads and beats the wings and pitches the neck and head down to dabble by each duck's INSTANCE_CUSTOM)
- [duck_flock.gd](scripts.fp.animals.md#scriptsfpanimalsduck_flockgd): The waterfowl's behaviour; the waterfowl node (waterfowl.gd) decides where flocks live (a spot on the water) and feeds in the world before every step()
- [perches.gd](scripts.fp.animals.md#scriptsfpanimalsperchesgd): The perched birds (part of the animals feature): pigeons that keep to the high perches by day, the same bird and behaviour as the sidewalk flocks (pigeon_body.gd, pigeon_flock.gd), the flock wiring shared with them (bird_flocks.gd)
- [pigeon_body.gd](scripts.fp.animals.md#scriptsfpanimalspigeon_bodygd): The pigeon every pigeon MultiMesh draws: one ArrayMesh built in code (metres, facing +Z, the feet at the origin) and its ShaderMaterial (pigeon.gdshader spreads and beats the wings, strides the legs, fans the tail and bobs and dips the head by each bird's INSTANCE_CUSTOM)
- [pigeon_flock.gd](scripts.fp.animals.md#scriptsfpanimalspigeon_flockgd): The pigeons' behaviour; the pigeons node (pigeons.gd) decides where flocks live and feeds in the world before every step()
- [pigeons.gd](scripts.fp.animals.md#scriptsfpanimalspigeonsgd): The pigeons (part of the animals feature): where flocks keep (the sidewalk in front of some shops and of the civic buildings people gather at, the parks, and a share of the plain street corners), coming out by day near the player and going beyond FAR; and where none of those is about, one ambient flock near the player (a young city shows pigeons from its first day)
- [proc_body.gd](scripts.fp.animals.md#scriptsfpanimalsproc_bodygd): The procedural animals' shared half (used by pigeon_body.gd, duck_body.gd and squirrel_body.gd): the arrays a body's mesh is built into and the shape builders that loft them — a tube of elliptic rings, an ellipsoid, a sheet through a grid of points and a thin beam
- [settle_lod.gd](scripts.fp.animals.md#scriptsfpanimalssettle_lodgd): Settled-state level of detail, shared by the animal life sims (pigeon_flock, squirrel_life, cat_life): an animal or flock with nothing going on, far from the hero, ticks at 4 Hz — the skipped time banks up and steps whole, so its timers keep pace
- [squirrel_body.gd](scripts.fp.animals.md#scriptsfpanimalssquirrel_bodygd): The squirrel every squirrel MultiMesh draws: one ArrayMesh built in code (metres, facing +Z, the feet at the origin) and its ShaderMaterial (squirrel.gdshader swings the four legs in a gallop, sits the front of the body up, sways the tail and leans the run by each animal's INSTANCE_CUSTOM)
- [squirrel_life.gd](scripts.fp.animals.md#scriptsfpanimalssquirrel_lifegd): The squirrels' behaviour; the squirrels node (squirrels.gd) decides where each keeps (a lawn and its tree), feeds the world before every step() and draws them (squirrel_body.gd's mesh, one MultiMesh)
- [squirrels.gd](scripts.fp.animals.md#scriptsfpanimalssquirrelsgd): The squirrels (part of the animals feature): where they keep (a lawn with a tree — the woods that ring the city, the street's own trees and the lots that have one), coming out by day near the player and going beyond FAR; the world fed to their behaviour (squirrel_life.gd) before every step; one MultiMesh of squirrel_body.gd's squirrel, one instance and tint a squirrel
- [street_spots.gd](scripts.fp.animals.md#scriptsfpanimalsstreet_spotsgd): Street-spot search shared by the animals feature's guaranteed spawns (pigeons.gd's ambient flock, cats.gd's ambient stray): the spot of the nearest straight road tile to someone, through each caller's own per-tile builder
- [waterfowl.gd](scripts.fp.animals.md#scriptsfpanimalswaterfowlgd): The waterfowl node: the ducks on the city's water (the river, the ponds), as the pigeons' two nodes are (bird_flocks.gd's shared half driving a duck_flock.gd list, one MultiMesh of the duck_body.gd duck an instance and tint a bird)

## [scripts/fp/arena/](scripts.fp.arena.md)

- [arena_column.gd](scripts.fp.arena.md#scriptsfparenaarena_columngd): One mayor's column in the Ask-the-five panel: the mayor's person name in their colour with the model's badge and the source tag in the sub-line, a bar that fills while the answer is awaited (and the seconds it took), the finish order ("1st".."5th" for live answers only), the orders it would give in plain words with the plausibility flags, the public post, the thought, and, for a recorded or offline column, the note that it did not hear the question
- [arena_feature.gd](scripts.fp.arena.md#scriptsfparenaarena_featuregd): Ask the five (integration feature "arena_ask"; docs/fp/ARCHITECTURE.md, Arena)
- [arena_panel.gd](scripts.fp.arena.md#scriptsfparenaarena_panelgd): The Ask-the-five panel (feature "arena_ask"): the overseer's question and five side-by-side columns, one per mayor, filling as their models answer (ArenaColumn): who finished first, what each thought, said and would do, and where each answer came from

## [scripts/fp/audio/](scripts.fp.audio.md)

- [ambience.gd](scripts.fp.audio.md#scriptsfpaudioambiencegd): Area ambience (slice I): looping 2D beds on the Ambience bus (traffic hum, park birds, river, the quiet residential bed, night insects and rain), weighted by what lies around the player and by the weather, and cross-faded over CROSSFADE_S
- [audio_bank.gd](scripts.fp.audio.md#scriptsfpaudioaudio_bankgd): Slice I's sound assets (sounds/fp/, made by tools/audio/synth_fp_sfx.py): names, a load-once stream cache and the mix
- [audio_feature.gd](scripts.fp.audio.md#scriptsfpaudioaudio_featuregd): City sound on foot (slice I)
- [emitter_pool.gd](scripts.fp.audio.md#scriptsfpaudioemitter_poolgd): The AudioStreamPlayer3D pool behind emitters.gd: at most MAX_PLAYERS players shared by every logical source (see emitter_src.gd)
- [emitter_src.gd](scripts.fp.audio.md#scriptsfpaudioemitter_srcgd): One logical sound source (see emitters.gd): a registered emitter that may hold a pooled AudioStreamPlayer3D while it is among the loudest at the listener
- [emitters.gd](scripts.fp.audio.md#scriptsfpaudioemittersgd): Positional city sound (slice I): logical sources (engines, horns, sirens, construction, fire, fountains, power plants, river banks, passers-by's footsteps, crashes, knocked props, car doors, blows and swings, dogs, pigeons, cats) share a pool of at most MAX_PLAYERS AudioStreamPlayer3D
- [footsteps.gd](scripts.fp.audio.md#scriptsfpaudiofootstepsgd): The hero's footsteps (slice I)

## [scripts/fp/brawl/](scripts.fp.brawl.md)

- [brawl_feature.gd](scripts.fp.brawl.md#scriptsfpbrawlbrawl_featuregd): Close combat (integration feature "brawl"; docs/fp/ARCHITECTURE.md, Brawl): grapples and the counter cue

## [scripts/fp/chat/](scripts.fp.chat.md)

- [chat_ask.gd](scripts.fp.chat.md#scriptsfpchatchat_askgd): The chat command "/ask <question>" (feature "arena_ask"): the question goes to all five mayors' models at once and the answers are only shown, never applied (ArenaAsk)
- [chat_facts.gd](scripts.fp.chat.md#scriptsfpchatchat_factsgd): What is really going on in the city, for chat answers (slice C): what the district's mayor did on their last turn in spoken words, their latest post, the Gazette headline, the council's last ruling, incidents and sites being built, and the district's numbers
- [chat_feature.gd](scripts.fp.chat.md#scriptsfpchatchat_featuregd): Global chat and face-to-face conversations (slice C)
- [chat_feed.gd](scripts.fp.chat.md#scriptsfpchatchat_feedgd) (`ChatFeed`): The global chat's message store and drip queue (slice C §1)
- [chat_text.gd](scripts.fp.chat.md#scriptsfpchatchat_textgd): Text helpers for the global chat and conversations (slice C): the display filter every line passes before it is shown or put into a prompt, dedupe normalisation, the checks the reply validators use (URLs, model names, sentence count), trimming, relative times and initials
- [mayor_voice.gd](scripts.fp.chat.md#scriptsfpchatmayor_voicegd): Who wrote a chat line credited to a mayor (finding F8 of the model audit)
- [street_lines.gd](scripts.fp.chat.md#scriptsfpchatstreet_linesgd): What the chat hears when the visitor hits someone in the street (game bus person_hit; see docs/fp/ARCHITECTURE.md, Body actions): the one who was hit says so (a shove, a punch, being knocked down, a car, being dragged out of their car) and one of the residents who saw it adds a line, and a crew called to the scene (incidents.gd: police after an assault or a carjack, an ambulance for someone a car knocked down) posts a City Alert card
- [talk_dialog.gd](scripts.fp.chat.md#scriptsfpchattalk_dialoggd): Face-to-face conversation with a resident (slice C §4), and the "Ask someone here" answer

## [scripts/fp/coach/](scripts.fp.coach.md)

- [coach_feature.gd](scripts.fp.coach.md#scriptsfpcoachcoach_featuregd): The coach card (integration feature "coach_card", flag coach_card): the first minute's guidance
- [coach_logic.gd](scripts.fp.coach.md#scriptsfpcoachcoach_logicgd): The coach card's pure rules (feature "coach_card"): what the welcome card says, what the context hints say and when each shows

## [scripts/fp/crews/](scripts.fp.crews.md)

- [crew_bodies.gd](scripts.fp.crews.md#scriptsfpcrewscrew_bodiesgd): The building crews' bodies: HC's trades avatars (roster group "trades"), each under a CharacterRoot scaled to a jittered stature and animated by its gender's clip library with the root motion pulled out, so a clip plays in place and the crew rig moves the worker
- [crew_card.gd](scripts.fp.crews.md#scriptsfpcrewscrew_cardgd): The player's crews on the HUD (feature "crews"), top left under the top bar: how many crews are free, a row per order a crew is on (the crew, the order, the time left, what the crew does now, a progress bar and how far away the site is) and the orders still waiting for a crew
- [crew_grid.gd](scripts.fp.crews.md#scriptsfpcrewscrew_gridgd): The places a crew can stand and walk on one construction site (feature "crews")
- [crew_rig.gd](scripts.fp.crews.md#scriptsfpcrewscrew_riggd): One crew at work on its site (feature "crews"): a foreman beside the gate keeping an eye on things, two builders at the spots nearest the middle and a hauler carrying crates from a pile inside the gate to a drop point by the builders, under a board that names the crew, the order, the stage and the time left
- [crew_spots.gd](scripts.fp.crews.md#scriptsfpcrewscrew_spotsgd): Where a crew works on a construction site, from the site's CrewGrid: the door just inside the gap ConstructionKit leaves in the hoarding toward the frontage road (a waypoint), the foreman's spot to one side of it and a pile to the other, work spots nearest the middle of the site (a little toward the gate) that the door reaches, a drop point by the first work spot with the hauler's way there and back, and the point outside the gate an arriving crew comes from
- [crews_feature.gd](scripts.fp.crews.md#scriptsfpcrewscrews_featuregd): The player's building crews (integration feature "crews")

## [scripts/fp/drive/](scripts.fp.drive.md)

- [backhoe.gd](scripts.fp.drive.md#scriptsfpdrivebackhoegd): The backhoe loader's arm rig, for drive_feature.gd
- [car_body.gd](scripts.fp.drive.md#scriptsfpdrivecar_bodygd): The player's car as a rigid box on the ground plane
- [car_entry.gd](scripts.fp.drive.md#scriptsfpdrivecar_entrygd): Getting into the player's car and out of it on foot, for drive_feature.gd (car_doors flag)
- [door_camera.gd](scripts.fp.drive.md#scriptsfpdrivedoor_cameragd): The camera beside the driver's door for the climb in and out (car_entry.gd): it looks at a point just outside the door from the front quarter on the driver's side, so that it sees the hero's front and the driver's, not the hero's back (from behind the door the hero's body hid the pull), and from the rear quarter when the front has too little room; pulled in front of walls
- [drive_feature.gd](scripts.fp.drive.md#scriptsfpdrivedrive_featuregd): Getting into cars and driving them
- [drive_hud.gd](scripts.fp.drive.md#scriptsfpdrivedrive_hudgd): The drive feature's HUD: the get-in / get-out key chip above the minimap line and a speedometer (km/h and the gear) at the bottom centre while driving, clear of the corner captions
- [drive_input.gd](scripts.fp.drive.md#scriptsfpdrivedrive_inputgd): The drive feature's input (drive_feature.gd): F takes or leaves a car (a second press on the way to the door turns back), V toggles the chase and driver views, the mouse orbits the chase camera, and H sounds the horn (a bicycle's bell, the night_driving flag) at most once per HORN_GAP — a press leaned on past HORN_LONG_S carries long through the street (horn_sounded, the horn_street flag)
- [drive_model.gd](scripts.fp.drive.md#scriptsfpdrivedrive_modelgd): Arcade handling for the player's car
- [hijack.gd](scripts.fp.drive.md#scriptsfpdrivehijackgd): The action hijack's moves (the drive feature's action_hijack flag): the hero, at the wheel of a car moving alongside another with someone at its wheel, climbs out through the window onto the roof on that car's side ("out"), leaps across onto the other car's roof ("leap") and swings down to its driver's window ("jack"), where he hangs on, a hand on the driver, while the driver stands on the brakes and the car pulls up ("hold")
- [hijack_grip.gd](scripts.fp.drive.md#scriptsfpdrivehijack_gripgd): The hero's hands in an action hijack (drive_feature.gd, hijack.gd): at the driver's window he takes hold of the driver with both hands (their collar and near upper arm, as in jack_hold.gd) over the swing down and keeps them while the car pulls up (the hold phase), and lets go as he drops to the road (the drop phase): the pull that takes the driver out of the seat is the stopped car's (jack_hold.gd), nothing is pulled out of a moving car
- [jack_hold.gd](scripts.fp.drive.md#scriptsfpdrivejack_holdgd): The hero's part in pulling a driver out of a car, from the first reach to letting go (car_entry.gd's jack phase with the carjack_throw flag): one sequence of four beats read from the driver, not a clock of fixed times
- [seat_pose.gd](scripts.fp.drive.md#scriptsfpdriveseat_posegd): The seated hero against the cabin, for drive_feature.gd

## [scripts/fp/health/](scripts.fp.health.md)

- [health_arc.gd](scripts.fp.health.md#scriptsfphealthhealth_arcgd): The hero's health (the health feature) as an arc round the left of the minimap in minimap_slot: it fills from the bottom up, green when well, amber below AMBER_AT and red below RED_AT, where it pulses; after a hurt a pale trail eats down to the new value
- [health_feature.gd](scripts.fp.health.md#scriptsfphealthhealth_featuregd): The hero's health (integration slice; docs/fp/ARCHITECTURE.md, Health): MAX_HP points, shown as an arc round the left of the minimap
- [health_screen.gd](scripts.fp.health.md#scriptsfphealthhealth_screengd): The health feature's full-screen layer in the overlay slot (under the pause menu): a red vignette that flashes with each hurt and stays, pulsing, while health is low, the direction marker's arc toward where a blow came from (hit_direction, first person — hit_wedge.gd), and the knock-out's fade to black with its caption
- [hit_wedge.gd](scripts.fp.health.md#scriptsfphealthhit_wedgegd): The blow-direction marker (hit_direction, first person): a short red arc a little in from the screen's edge, toward the side a blow came from (angle 0 dead ahead, +PI/2 from the right, PI from behind), fading away over about FADE_S

## [scripts/fp/hitfeel/](scripts.fp.hitfeel.md)

- [hitfeel_feature.gd](scripts.fp.hitfeel.md#scriptsfphitfeelhitfeel_featuregd): Hit feel (integration feature "hit_feel"; docs/fp/ARCHITECTURE.md, Hit feel): what a blow feels like

## [scripts/fp/interact/](scripts.fp.interact.md)

- [interact_feature.gd](scripts.fp.interact.md#scriptsfpinteractinteract_featuregd): Interaction with residents, buildings, posters and cars (slice A deliverables 3 and 6.7)

## [scripts/fp/melee/](scripts.fp.melee.md)

- [melee_feature.gd](scripts.fp.melee.md#scriptsfpmeleemelee_featuregd): Melee weapons (integration feature "melee"; docs/fp/ARCHITECTURE.md, Melee weapons): a baseball bat, a steel pipe or a bottle lying about the city for the hero to pick up and swing
- [weapon_kit.gd](scripts.fp.melee.md#scriptsfpmeleeweapon_kitgd): The weapons the hero can pick up (the melee feature): what each one is and its mesh, built here from a lathe profile, so no model files are needed

## [scripts/fp/overview/](scripts.fp.overview.md)

- [overview_feature.gd](scripts.fp.overview.md#scriptsfpoverviewoverview_featuregd): City overview: Tab lifts the camera off the hero into an aerial view of the city, with a marker over every open construction site and a list of them

## [scripts/fp/parkour/](scripts.fp.parkour.md)

- [climb.gd](scripts.fp.parkour.md#scriptsfpparkourclimbgd): The hero on a wall (the parkour feature's wall climb; wall.gd finds walls and the spots on them): the leap from the ground onto the wall, then up, down and along it at climbing pace, never past its ends, over its top or into anything in the way
- [moves.gd](scripts.fp.parkour.md#scriptsfpparkourmovesgd): Plans what a jump press in front of an obstacle becomes (the parkour feature): a vault over a low, thin obstacle with room to land beyond it, a hop up onto a low ledge, or a climb up onto a higher one with room to stand on top; and the roll a hard landing becomes (roll())
- [parkour_feature.gd](scripts.fp.parkour.md#scriptsfpparkourparkour_featuregd): Parkour (integration slice; docs/fp/ARCHITECTURE.md, Parkour): jump in front of an obstacle and the hero gets over it instead of jumping against it
- [wall.gd](scripts.fp.parkour.md#scriptsfpparkourwallgd): Where the hero can hang on a wall (the parkour feature's wall climb; climb.gd moves the body on it)

## [scripts/fp/phone/](scripts.fp.phone.md)

- [build_ghost.gd](scripts.fp.phone.md#scriptsfpphonebuild_ghostgd): The Build app's marker in the world: on every tile the order would touch, a glowing floor slab and a faint column that reads from down the street, cyan when it can be placed and amber when not, and a ring on the first corner of a road or zone
- [build_rules.gd](scripts.fp.phone.md#scriptsfpphonebuild_rulesgd): Read-only previews for the phone Build app
- [phone_feature.gd](scripts.fp.phone.md#scriptsfpphonephone_featuregd): The phone and its Build app (integration feature "phone")
- [phone_ui.gd](scripts.fp.phone.md#scriptsfpphonephone_uigd): The Build app's phone: who you build for (the district, its mayor and treasury), the six tools, the building picked for the Build tool, what placing here would do, the player's crews, and the keys

## [scripts/fp/player/](scripts.fp.player.md)

- [body_bake.gd](scripts.fp.player.md#scriptsfpplayerbody_bakegd): Bakes the walking collision of every building and zone model into body_table.gd (slice A)
- [body_shapes.gd](scripts.fp.player.md#scriptsfpplayerbody_shapesgd): Walking collision of a building or zone model from its own geometry (slice A deliverable 2)
- [body_table.gd](scripts.fp.player.md#scriptsfpplayerbody_tablegd): Generated by body_bake.gd from 114 models; do not edit by hand
- [foot_fit.gd](scripts.fp.player.md#scriptsfpplayerfoot_fitgd): The hero's feet on the ground they stand on (flag ground_foot_fit)
- [heel_strike.gd](scripts.fp.player.md#scriptsfpplayerheel_strikegd): Where a heel comes down in one sampled gait cycle, for the hero rig's feet analysis (hero_rig.gd): the sample near the nominal strike where the heel gets within EPS of its lowest
- [hero_fk.gd](scripts.fp.player.md#scriptsfpplayerhero_fkgd): Forward kinematics over a body's own clip keys, without a tree or a scene: where the last bone of a chain sits at a phase of one clip or of two clips blended (rotations slerped, positions lerped)
- [hero_kick_pose.gd](scripts.fp.player.md#scriptsfpplayerhero_kick_posegd): The front kick's foot path in the body's frame (right, up, forward, metres)
- [hero_limbs.gd](scripts.fp.player.md#scriptsfpplayerhero_limbsgd): The hero's hands and feet on holds (slice A; hero_rig.gd, for the parkour feature's wall climb): a TwoBoneIK3D a limb (upper arm, forearm and hand; thigh, shin and foot) reaches the end bone for a target with the elbow or knee bent toward a pole, both top-level Marker3Ds placed in world space
- [hero_look.gd](scripts.fp.player.md#scriptsfpplayerhero_lookgd): The hero's head look (A-player.md 6.9; hero_rig.gd): LookAtModifier3Ds on Neck and Head turn the head toward a look target within the head's limits, the Neck taking a share of the turn
- [hero_palms.gd](scripts.fp.player.md#scriptsfpplayerhero_palmsgd): Turning the hero's hands about the wrist so that their palms face a given direction (hero_strike_pose.gd, pulling someone out of a car: the fists wrap the collar and the arm, they do not float at them)
- [hero_rig.gd](scripts.fp.player.md#scriptsfpplayerhero_riggd): HC's animated hero for the player (slice A stage A2; A-player.md 6.9, TPS_PLAN 2.9)
- [hero_strike_pose.gd](scripts.fp.player.md#scriptsfpplayerhero_strike_posegd): The hero's strike pose layer (hero_rig.gd, like hero_look.gd and hero_limbs.gd): what makes a strike read as the whole body's work
- [placeholder_puppet.gd](scripts.fp.player.md#scriptsfpplayerplaceholder_puppetgd): The legacy person (models/real/people/person_*.glb) re-rigged as a jointed puppet, so the placeholder hero walks, runs, crouches and jumps until HC's animated hero replaces it (stage A2)
- [player.gd](scripts.fp.player.md#scriptsfpplayerplayergd) (`FpPlayer`): The on-foot player (slice A): feet at `position`, a kinematic controller against the analytic CollisionWorld (no physics bodies, D2) and the one current Camera3D
- [player_avatar.gd](scripts.fp.player.md#scriptsfpplayerplayer_avatargd): The player's visible body (slice A)
- [spring_math.gd](scripts.fp.player.md#scriptsfpplayerspring_mathgd) (`SpringMath`): Frame-rate independent dampers and springs for the player and the third-person camera
- [tps_rig.gd](scripts.fp.player.md#scriptsfpplayertps_riggd) (`TpsRig`): Over-the-shoulder follow camera (D13; docs/fp/slices/A-player.md 6.5-6.6): an analytic spring arm root -> shoulder -> hand -> camera, swept against CollisionWorld boxes (no physics, D2)
- [wade.gd](scripts.fp.player.md#scriptsfpplayerwadegd): The hero in water (flag hero_wade): the numbers FpPlayer reads while wading, written once and const-only so tests can pin them

## [scripts/fp/posters/](scripts.fp.posters.md)

- [poster_art.gd](scripts.fp.posters.md#scriptsfppostersposter_artgd): Poster palettes and the procedural fallback art (slice D): a soft two-tone gradient in the colours of the poster's kind (or its mayor), so a poster is never blank offline or while its image is on the way
- [poster_compositor.gd](scripts.fp.posters.md#scriptsfppostersposter_compositorgd): Draws poster text over poster images (slice D): a one-shot SubViewport (update mode ONCE) holds the image and the layout's panels and Labels (Lilita One for display type, system serif and sans for newspaper and body copy), the result is read back asynchronously (RenderingDevice texture_get_data_async, so the main thread never stalls on the GPU), mipmapped and VRAM-compressed on a background thread and wrapped in an ImageTexture
- [poster_director.gd](scripts.fp.posters.md#scriptsfppostersposter_directorgd): Decides what each poster carrier shows (slice D): mayors' campaigns on billboards in their own districts, the GridFall Gazette at bus shelters, shop ads named after the real businesses, "Coming soon" hoardings on construction sites, ordinance and incident notices on homes and workshops, protest flyers after a district protest, and lease boards
- [poster_feature.gd](scripts.fp.posters.md#scriptsfppostersposter_featuregd): Campaign, newspaper, shop and notice posters on the streets (slice D)
- [poster_layouts.gd](scripts.fp.posters.md#scriptsfppostersposter_layoutsgd): Poster layouts (slice D): what the compositor draws over a poster image for each family and aspect
- [poster_surfaces.gd](scripts.fp.posters.md#scriptsfppostersposter_surfacesgd): Finds poster carriers on CityView's tile holders and gives each one poster faces (slice D)
- [poster_worker.gd](scripts.fp.posters.md#scriptsfppostersposter_workergd): One background thread that runs poster image jobs in order (slice D): decode, resize, WebP, mipmaps and VRAM compression
- [wall_spot_baker.gd](scripts.fp.posters.md#scriptsfpposterswall_spot_bakergd): Offline bake of wall-poster spots (slice D)

## [scripts/fp/props/](scripts.fp.props.md)

- [props_feature.gd](scripts.fp.props.md#scriptsfppropsprops_featuregd): Street props that the player's car, the hero on foot, people and traffic knock about (integration feature "props")
- [tumble.gd](scripts.fp.props.md#scriptsfppropstumblegd): A street prop knocked over (props feature): its bounding box flies off, tips over about one of its own level axes, lands, rolls on over its edges while it comes down hard, slides to a stop and lies on a face

## [scripts/fp/render/](scripts.fp.render.md)

- [hlod.gd](scripts.fp.render.md#scriptsfprenderhlodgd): Visibility ranges and building LODs (slice G2)
- [midlod.gd](scripts.fp.render.md#scriptsfprendermidlodgd): Mid-range building LOD (slice G2): a building mesh's surfaces merged into one, each carrying its material's average colour (proxies.json, else albedo_color) as vertex colour, with generated LODs
- [occluders.gd](scripts.fp.render.md#scriptsfprenderoccludersgd): Occluders (slice G2): one ArrayOccluder3D per 8x8-tile chunk inside one OccluderInstance3D, holding a box per solid building (hlod.gd's "solid" entries): the body box from proxies.gd, inset 15% of its width on every side and cut to 0.8 of its height, so a box never hides what shows past the building's edges
- [proxies.gd](scripts.fp.render.md#scriptsfprenderproxiesgd): Building proxies for far impostors and occluders (slice G2): per model path, the body box and a low-poly stepped mass mesh template (tops coloured by what covers each cell, facades by the model's average facade colour) built from the offline bake in proxies.json (proxy_bake.gd)
- [proxy_bake.gd](scripts.fp.render.md#scriptsfprenderproxy_bakegd): Offline bake of building proxies for G2's far impostors and occluders
- [quality.gd](scripts.fp.render.md#scriptsfprenderqualitygd): First-person quality presets (slice G2): the knobs each preset sets, and the static helpers every slice reads without a feature lookup (vis_mult, max_street_lights, camera_far)
- [render_opt_feature.gd](scripts.fp.render.md#scriptsfprenderrender_opt_featuregd): Render performance (slice G2): applies the quality preset (FSR2 scaling, shadow atlas and filter, SSAO and SSIL quality, mesh LOD threshold, camera far plane, and the Environment's SSAO switch, off on Compatibility while the view renders below native size) and restores every knob on teardown; on foot it ranges every tile holder's parts (hlod.gd), draws far buildings as merged chunk impostors and culls with per-chunk occluders (occluders.gd; not in the browser, see web)

## [scripts/fp/reporter/](scripts.fp.reporter.md)

- [health_dot.gd](scripts.fp.reporter.md#scriptsfpreporterhealth_dotgd): A small health light (the league's mayor cell and its services page): a drawn shape, not text, coloured by ModelLedger health, with the sentence for it as its tooltip
- [league_ledger.gd](scripts.fp.reporter.md#scriptsfpreporterleague_ledgergd): What the model ledger (scripts/ai/model_ledger.gd) adds to the street's mayors' league: an "Orders" column (the share of a mayor's orders the city carried out), a "Speed" column (the typical time to answer, or what to read instead when no live answer has come) and a health light beside the name
- [league_minds.gd](scripts.fp.reporter.md#scriptsfpreporterleague_mindsgd): The league's second page, "Services & minds": the minds that work for the city outside the mayors' chairs (the Gazette, the Council Speaker, the Chaos Director, the Grid Operator, Citizen Voices, the Street Inspector, the residents' minds and the chat voices), one row per model with what it has been asked to do, how many calls, how many answered live, failed, came from a recording or were answered by the scripted planner, the typical time to answer and a health light
- [reporter_card.gd](scripts.fp.reporter.md#scriptsfpreporterreporter_cardgd): The Gazette card on the HUD (feature "reporter"), bottom right above the district caption: the newest lead and the key to take it, or the story on assignment: what happened, where and how far, the scoop clock, the quote so far and what the story still needs (the scene, a quote, a photo), with the key to file it
- [reporter_desk.gd](scripts.fp.reporter.md#scriptsfpreporterreporter_deskgd): The Gazette's desk (feature "reporter"): which AI decisions make a lead and how they read ("Viktor Han ordered a Police Station"), what a filed story says and earns, the press ranks, what a photo must frame, and the mayors' league (people, jobs, approval and funds, worth 25 points each)
- [reporter_feature.gd](scripts.fp.reporter.md#scriptsfpreporterreporter_featuregd): The Gazette's stringer (integration feature "reporter"; docs/fp/ARCHITECTURE.md, Reporter)
- [reporter_league.gd](scripts.fp.reporter.md#scriptsfpreporterreporter_leaguegd): The mayors' league (feature "reporter", L): the five AI mayors ranked on people, jobs, approval and funds (25 points each, ReporterDesk.standings), each with the badge of the model they run on, then the player's press card (rank, points, stories filed), the story on assignment, the open leads with a button to chase one, and the latest stories
- [reporter_viewfinder.gd](scripts.fp.reporter.md#scriptsfpreporterreporter_viewfindergd): The press camera's viewfinder (feature "reporter"), over the view in photo mode while a story is on assignment: corner marks round the middle of the view a press photo must hold the scene in (ReporterDesk.FRAME), green while it does, the story above the marks and what to do below them, the last shot's result under that, and a white flash for the shutter

## [scripts/fp/sim/](scripts.fp.sim.md)

- [sim_perf_feature.gd](scripts.fp.sim.md#scriptsfpsimsim_perf_featuregd): Time-sliced sim ticks for first person (slice F)

## [scripts/fp/street/](scripts.fp.street.md)

- [light_profile.gd](scripts.fp.street.md#scriptsfpstreetlight_profilegd): First-person light profile (slice G1): shadow distance and cascades, SSAO and SSIL radii, depth fog, volumetric fog, screen-space reflections and the sky's radiance update, in world units for street level
- [street_dressing.gd](scripts.fp.street.md#scriptsfpstreetstreet_dressinggd): Street-level dressing that CityView adds to its tile holders in fp_mode (slice G1): furniture and street trees on road sidewalks, everyday clutter (traffic cones by construction sites, wheelie bins, cartons), street-name signs at junctions, road wear and puddle decals, crosswalk ramps, sidewalk aprons in front of lots, vacant lots with lease boards and billboards, the bus shelter, and the street-level glass and leaf materials
- [street_lights.gd](scripts.fp.street.md#scriptsfpstreetstreet_lightsgd): Real light pools under the street lamps near the player (slice G1): a fixed pool of shadowless OmniLight3Ds, re-assigned four times a second to the nearest Bulb_* nodes within REACH of the player and dimmed with the night
- [streetscape_feature.gd](scripts.fp.street.md#scriptsfpstreetstreetscape_featuregd): Street-level look on foot (slice G1)
- [weather.gd](scripts.fp.street.md#scriptsfpstreetweathergd): Street weather (slice G1): a deterministic daily state (clear 60%, overcast 25%, rain 15%) from the city seed and day, forced by incidents (a flood brings rain, smog a brown haze), drives SkyDirector's weather hooks, CityView's wetness and rain, the street profile's reflections and the global `wetness` shader parameter, a rain-streak emitter that follows the camera (off while the Tab overview is open or the camera is high over the player, in the web tier) and drops splashing off the ground round the player

## [scripts/fp/surface/](scripts.fp.surface.md)

- [surface_feel_feature.gd](scripts.fp.surface.md#scriptsfpsurfacesurface_feel_featuregd): The dust a sprint kicks up (feature "surface_feel", the flag of the same name; the footsteps' level and pitch are footsteps.gd's and the speed factor is FpPlayer's, both from scripts/fp/world/surface_feel.gd)

## [scripts/fp/traffic/](scripts.fp.traffic.md)

- [ambient.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficambientgd): Ambient filler (docs/fp/slices/E-traffic.md §6): unnamed commuters (some of them cyclists) and pedestrians around the player, denser where sim.traffic and residents' trip_load are high (caps 40 vehicles, 60 people)
- [body_spheres.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficbody_spheresgd): The posed body's collision points, and the press-out that keeps a knocked-down or thrown body out of the geometry its clips sweep it into
- [car_doors.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficcar_doorsgd): The driver's door of a full car model (vehicles_v2) as a part of its own that swings open on a hinge at its front edge
- [carjack.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficcarjackgd): Taking a car with someone at the wheel (the carjack flag; docs/fp/ARCHITECTURE.md, Driving): a car stopped or crawling in traffic is the player's to take, an ambient driver's or a resident's, and its driver is dragged out first
- [contact_shadows.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficcontact_shadowsgd): Contact shadows: a soft dark patch on the ground under every drawn vehicle and person, all in one MultiMesh draw
- [crowd_reacts.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficcrowd_reactsgd): The crowd's answer to what the street sees and hears, split out of reactions.gd (which keeps the Reaction records, the blow, the fall and the witness loop that picks who reacts): a knock-down rocks the onlookers who stay back as one (crowd_gasp), and the hero's horn startles the people it reaches (horn_street)
- [fight_back.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficfight_backgd): The scrap and the care for a body on the ground: fighting back, the tempers, counter cues and downed awareness, split out of reactions.gd
- [fleets.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficfleetsgd): City fleets on lanes in first person (docs/fp/slices/E-traffic.md §5): buses on 2-4 seeded closed lines through the bus stops (they pull in at each shelter, people board and alight), delivery and garbage trucks, and emergency crews that run to incidents with sirens (through red lights at walking pace once the box is clear), wait at the scene, and drive back to the station
- [heap.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficheapgd): Binary min-heap of (priority, int item) for the lane and sidewalk A* searches
- [idm.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficidmgd): Intelligent Driver Model (Treiber 2000) in world units (docs/fp/slices/E-traffic.md §3)
- [incidents.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficincidentsgd): What a blow in the street means for the city (traffic_feature.gd hit_walker): a resident who was hit remembers it and their mood drops (a shove least, a car or a carjack most, more when knocked down), and residents who saw it remember it too
- [indicators.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficindicatorsgd): Turn signals: which side a car's indicators blink on, and when a blinking lamp is lit
- [jack_cab.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficjack_cabgd): Taking the driver out of a body with no door that opens (a bus, a truck, a bicycle, a scooter: traffic's door_info "doorless", carjack.gd): there is a solid side (the cab's skin, the frame or the footboard) between the seat and the road where a car has its door's opening, and the haul of jack_pull.gd must not draw the driver through it
- [jack_grip.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficjack_gripgd): Where the hero's two hands take hold of the driver he pulls out of a car (carjack.gd grips, the hero's part in car_entry.gd): read per frame from the driver's own skeleton, so they follow the body as it leans, is drawn out of the seat and lands
- [jack_landing.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficjack_landinggd): Where the driver the hero pulls out of a car comes down, and what they are kept clear of on the way (the carjack_throw flag; jack_pull.gd has the motion, carjack.gd asks for the numbers): they come out of the door straight out from the seat and sit down a short way beyond the sill, lying along the car's side as they sat (head to the rear, feet toward the front: the feet, which the hero steps in beside, are not at the sill as they would be lying across the car, head to the road)
- [jack_pull.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficjack_pullgd): How the driver the hero pulls out of a car goes, from the seat to the road (the carjack_throw flag, which needs hit_feel: on(); docs/fp/ARCHITECTURE.md, Integration: driving), as one sequence on the clips the walkers already have
- [junctions.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficjunctionsgd): Junction control (docs/fp/slices/E-traffic.md §2): 4-way traffic lights on cross tiles (N-S green, amber, all-red, E-W green, ...), priority to the through road on tees, pedestrian walk phases, and the street furniture that shows them: light poles at the four corners, pedestrian signals at both ends of every zebra, and stop or yield signs on tee stems
- [lane_graph.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficlane_graphgd): Right-hand lane graph over the road tiles (docs/fp/slices/E-traffic.md §1)
- [mesh_kit.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficmesh_kitgd): Builds merged, vertex-coloured meshes for E's procedural stand-ins (traffic lights, signs, the far LOD of every vehicle and person model)
- [occupants.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficoccupantsgd): Drivers seated in the moving vehicles nearest the camera
- [people.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficpeoplegd): Animated people from HC's roster (docs/fp/slices/E-traffic.md deliverable 9, TPS_PLAN §1.10-1.11)
- [people_kit.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficpeople_kitgd): Asset building for people.gd: the layered clips (a box held in both hands, a phone at the ear), the shared T0 AnimationTree, and HC's lod1 meshes as dither-fading T3 MultiMesh layers; the clips reactions.gd plays (blows, falls, running off) and how their time runs
- [people_pool.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficpeople_poolgd): The body pool and scene cache behind people.gd (split out so people.gd stays under the 1000-line cap; the public API stays on people, which delegates here)
- [police_bust.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficpolice_bustgd): The hero taken by the police (police_response.gd, the police_response flag)
- [police_response.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficpolice_responsegd): The police answering the hero's offence (the police_response flag; docs/fp/ARCHITECTURE.md, E Traffic & pedestrians)
- [reactions.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficreactionsgd): People hit in the street (docs/fp/ARCHITECTURE.md, Body actions): shoved or punched by the player, struck by the car they drive or dragged out of their own (carjack)
- [render.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficrendergd): Draws E's agents (docs/fp/slices/E-traffic.md §3 Draw calls)
- [shoves.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficshovesgd): Cars the player's car knocks (slice E): a hit car slides off with the momentum it was given and spins, braking on its tyres, and stops against walls and other cars
- [sidewalks.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficsidewalksgd): Pedestrian network (docs/fp/slices/E-traffic.md §3 Pedestrians): sidewalk polylines whose centrelines sit at the middle of WS.PED_BAND from the road centreline, joined around junction corners, around corner tiles and around cul-de-sacs, plus a zebra edge across every arm of a tee or cross
- [throw_impact.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficthrow_impactgd): A thrown or flung body meeting a wall or a solid prop mid-flight (the throw_impact flag; docs/fp/ARCHITECTURE.md, Integration: brawl)
- [traffic_feature.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptraffictraffic_featuregd): Traffic and pedestrians on lanes (slice E, docs/fp/slices/E-traffic.md): one road-agent system for first person
- [trips.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptraffictripsgd): Resident trips (docs/fp/slices/E-traffic.md §4): the AI link
- [trips_parked.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptraffictrips_parkedgd): The residents' own parked cars (trips.gd): each resident's car is made once and parked near their lot between trips, an out-of-sight decor car giving up its slot for it, and the parked table is the save's record of who sits where
- [vehicles.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficvehiclesgd): Every road vehicle (docs/fp/slices/E-traffic.md §3): ambient filler, resident cars, buses, trucks, crews and cyclists
- [walkers.gd](scripts.fp.traffic.md#scriptsfptrafficwalkersgd): People on foot (docs/fp/slices/E-traffic.md §3 Pedestrians): they walk the sidewalk network at PED_WALK ±15 %, keep right when they meet, keep 0.6 m apart, follow slower walkers, sidestep the posts baked into lit straights, the light poles and the player, and cross only on zebras: in their walk phase at lights, or at tees when no car is within 2 s

## [scripts/fp/ui/](scripts.fp.ui.md)

- [chat_panel.gd](scripts.fp.ui.md#scriptsfpuichat_panelgd): The global chat panel (slice C §2), Clash of Clans style: a drawer that slides out of the left edge of chat_slot (440 px) with a 20 px edge tab and an unread badge, City / District tabs, the pinned Gazette headline, one row per message (round avatar, role-coloured name, district badge, relative time, reply arrow) or a tinted system card, a "New messages" pill while scrolled up and the input line
- [chat_panel_row.gd](scripts.fp.ui.md#scriptsfpuichat_panel_rowgd): One chat message drawn as a single Control (slice C §2): a resident, mayor, press, council or player row (round avatar, role-coloured name, role tag and district chips, job, relative time, reply arrow with a quote of the parent, word-wrapped text in a speech bubble) or a full-width system card (tinted, accent rim, icon, title, time, text)
- [chat_panel_style.gd](scripts.fp.ui.md#scriptsfpuichat_panel_stylegd): Look of the chat panel and the talk dialogue (slice C): palette, fonts, style boxes, vector icons drawn in code (the project fonts carry no arrow or emoji glyphs) and the small custom controls' drawing helpers (chat_panel_widgets.gd holds the controls)
- [chat_panel_ticker.gd](scripts.fp.ui.md#scriptsfpuichat_panel_tickergd): One line of the collapsed chat ticker (slice C §2): the author (or the card title) in its colour and the text after it, at most two lines, drawn with a dark outline and no background so it reads over the street
- [chat_panel_widgets.gd](scripts.fp.ui.md#scriptsfpuichat_panel_widgetsgd): Small passive controls of the chat panel and the talk dialogue (slice C): a vector icon, a round avatar with initials, a mood face and typing dots
- [fp_hud.gd](scripts.fp.ui.md#scriptsfpuifp_hudgd) (`FpHud`): The lean on-foot HUD (slice B): named slots the HUD, chat and other slices fill, and B's widgets in them: indicator chips and the compass (top_bar), toasts and the alert banner (toasts), the rotating minimap and street label (minimap_slot), the interact prompt, first-person crosshair and district caption (center), and the pause menu, place card and full map (overlay)
- [gmi_key_panel.gd](scripts.fp.ui.md#scriptsfpuigmi_key_panelgd) (`GmiKeyPanel`): The "GMI Cloud" page of the pause menu settings (slice B): the opt-in "bring your own key" field
- [gps_route.gd](scripts.fp.ui.md#scriptsfpuigps_routegd): GPS route for the waypoint (slice B): a breadth-first search over road tiles from the road nearest the player to the road nearest the waypoint, returned as world points (x, z) with only the corners kept: the player, every turn, the waypoint
- [hud_caption.gd](scripts.fp.ui.md#scriptsfpuihud_captiongd): District caption (slice B), bottom right of the "center" slot: on arrival and whenever the player walks into another district, its name in the display face with its mayor under it, sliding in over 0.4 s, held for 4 s and faded out
- [hud_chips.gd](scripts.fp.ui.md#scriptsfpuihud_chipsgd): Top-centre indicator chips (slice B): population, mood and treasury on the left of the clock chip (day, time, speed); power, water, alerts and the "City hall in session" dot on its right, so the clock stays centred while the alert chips come and go
- [hud_compass.gd](scripts.fp.ui.md#scriptsfpuihud_compassgd): Compass strip (slice B), top centre under the chips: ticks and cardinal letters for the view heading on a soft backing band, plus the waypoint and up to 3 pings drawn on the strip (a letter under a marker fades out) with their distance in metres below
- [hud_icon.gd](scripts.fp.ui.md#scriptsfpuihud_icongd): A small vector icon drawn in code (no texture assets), crisp at any window scale: person, face, coin, bolt, drop, clock, alert, speed, info, check, pin, dot, hall
- [hud_prompt.gd](scripts.fp.ui.md#scriptsfpuihud_promptgd): Interact prompt and crosshair (slice B), in the "center" slot
- [hud_style.gd](scripts.fp.ui.md#scriptsfpuihud_stylegd): Shared look of the on-foot HUD (slice B): colour tokens, fonts with tabular figures, and the widget helpers (restyled from city_hud.gd's _panel, _label and _fmt)
- [hud_toasts.gd](scripts.fp.ui.md#scriptsfpuihud_toastsgd): Toasts and the alert banner (slice B), laid out by hand in the "toasts" slot so they can slide: at most 3 toasts with a 4 s life, identical consecutive toasts collapse into one ("×2"), each slides and fades in and out over 0.2 s, and the stack closes up smoothly
- [hud_widgets_feature.gd](scripts.fp.ui.md#scriptsfpuihud_widgets_featuregd): Lean HUD widgets (slice B): owns the minimap tile model and the waypoint, binds them to FpHud (minimap, full map, compass), keeps the model painted (per tile on tiles_changed, per district on territory_changed, in full on world_ready), closes B's transient UI after a load and saves the waypoint as {"waypoint": [x, z]}
- [map_screen.gd](scripts.fp.ui.md#scriptsfpuimap_screengd): Full-screen map (slice B) on M: the minimap's tile images at large size, north up, with district names, street names (from the directory) at 6 px per tile and closer, incidents, pings, the waypoint and the player
- [minimap_model.gd](scripts.fp.ui.md#scriptsfpuiminimap_modelgd): The minimap's tile images (slice B), one pixel per tile of the 192 x 192 world: `image` holds the display colour, `data` the shape class, level and district the map shader draws from (roads joined to their neighbours, inset buildings, smooth shores), and `survey` one texel per 16 x 16 plot (unsurveyed land is hazed)
- [minimap_view.gd](scripts.fp.ui.md#scriptsfpuiminimap_viewgd): The rotating circular minimap (slice B) in minimap_slot: the model's 192 x 192 tile images drawn by ui/fp/map.gdshader in a 200 px circle (soft edge, thin ring, no square frame), rotated every frame so the view heading points up, with markers drawn on top at 12 Hz (player arrow, waypoint, pings, incidents, nearby residents and E's agents) and the street label under it
- [pause_menu.gd](scripts.fp.ui.md#scriptsfpuipause_menugd): Pause menu (slice B), shown on pause_changed(true) over a frosted blur of the paused world: Resume, Save, Load, New city (press twice), Settings, Planner view, Quit (saves first), a legend of the HUD icons, and tabbed settings (Camera, Controls, Display, Audio) written through mode.apply_settings()
- [place_card.gd](scripts.fp.ui.md#scriptsfpuiplace_cardgd): Place card (slice B) on interact_requested for kinds building, vehicle and pedestrian (a named resident is C's conversation, never a card)

## [scripts/fp/warmup/](scripts.fp.warmup.md)

- [planner_prep.gd](scripts.fp.warmup.md#scriptsfpwarmupplanner_prepgd) (`PlannerPrep`): "Preparing the Planner view": the honest way through the two moves that freeze the web page
- [render_info.gd](scripts.fp.warmup.md#scriptsfpwarmuprender_infogd) (`RenderInfo`): Web probe aid (flag web_first_use_marks, web only): every SECONDS prints one console line with what the renderer drew in the last frame of the main viewport, so a Planner or street change shows its effect in objects, primitives and draw calls, separately for the visible pass and the shadow passes
- [shader_warmup.gd](scripts.fp.warmup.md#scriptsfpwarmupshader_warmupgd) (`ShaderWarmup`): Shader warm-up for the web build
- [shadow_hold.gd](scripts.fp.warmup.md#scriptsfpwarmupshadow_holdgd) (`WarmShadowHold`): Holds the sun and the fog in another state for the frames of one warm-up state, then puts them back
- [warm_collector.gd](scripts.fp.warmup.md#scriptsfpwarmupwarm_collectorgd) (`WarmCollector`): Finds the draws the scene will make, as a list of recipes, one per distinct material: a material on a plain mesh, on a MultiMesh (with or without per-instance colours and custom data), casting shadows or not, is one recipe, whatever meshes carry it
- [warm_signature.gd](scripts.fp.warmup.md#scriptsfpwarmupwarm_signaturegd) (`WarmSignature`): What decides which shader programs a material needs, as a short string: two materials with the same signature link the same programs (the browser's driver caches by generated source), so the warm-up draws one of them, not all fifteen hundred a grown city holds
- [warm_stage.gd](scripts.fp.warmup.md#scriptsfpwarmupwarm_stagegd) (`WarmStage`): The warm-up's stage: a Node3D parked a few metres in front of the active camera that holds one tiny copy of each recipe (WarmCollector) for a frame

## [scripts/fp/water/](scripts.fp.water.md)

- [wade_feature.gd](scripts.fp.water.md#scriptsfpwaterwade_featuregd): The hero wading (feature "hero_wade", the flag of the same name; its movement half lives in FpPlayer and CollisionWorld)

## [scripts/fp/world/](scripts.fp.world.md)

- [collision_world.gd](scripts.fp.world.md#scriptsfpworldcollision_worldgd) (`CollisionWorld`): Analytic on-foot collision (slice A; no physics engine, D2): walkable ground height per point, blocking boxes and prop cylinders per tile, water
- [ground_profile.gd](scripts.fp.world.md#scriptsfpworldground_profilegd) (`GroundProfile`): The height of the ground under a point of a land tile, written once
- [riverbed.gd](scripts.fp.world.md#scriptsfpworldriverbedgd): The river-bed height, written once
- [surface_feel.gd](scripts.fp.world.md#scriptsfpworldsurface_feelgd): What each ground surface feels like to the hero (flag surface_feel), written once: the footstep set and its level and pitch, how much slower the surface is to run on, and how much dust a sprint kicks up

## [scripts/ops/](scripts.ops.md)

- [alerts.gd](scripts.ops.md#scriptsopsalertsgd) (`OpsAlerts`): Local alerting
- [analytics.gd](scripts.ops.md#scriptsopsanalyticsgd) (`Analytics`): Local, opt-in product analytics: track(event, props) appends {event, props, session, seq, ts, build} to user://ops/analytics.jsonl (scrubbed, rotated)
- [boot_clock.gd](scripts.ops.md#scriptsopsboot_clockgd) (`BootClock`): Boot stage stopwatch
- [circuit_breaker.gd](scripts.ops.md#scriptsopscircuit_breakergd) (`CircuitBreaker`): Consecutive-failure circuit breaker
- [error_tracker.gd](scripts.ops.md#scriptsopserror_trackergd) (`ErrorTracker`): Contextual error tracking, registered with OS.add_logger()
- [feature_flags.gd](scripts.ops.md#scriptsopsfeature_flagsgd) (`FeatureFlags`): Feature flags
- [first_use.gd](scripts.ops.md#scriptsopsfirst_usegd) (`FirstUse`): First-use marks and stopwatches for the web build: the game half of the hitch-attribution kit (docs/runbooks/web-probe-kit.md)
- [gpu_memory.gd](scripts.ops.md#scriptsopsgpu_memorygd) (`GpuMemory`): Low-GPU-memory mode
- [ops_sink.gd](scripts.ops.md#scriptsopsops_sinkgd) (`OpsSink`): Local JSON-lines files for the opt-in ops features (errors, analytics, alerts)
- [pacing.gd](scripts.ops.md#scriptsopspacinggd) (`Pacing`): Step lengths for the per-frame catch-up loops (traffic, birds, animals): a long frame, or a high game speed, hands them a big delta that they work off in steps of at most MAX_STEP
- [pack_loader.gd](scripts.ops.md#scriptsopspack_loadergd) (`PackLoader`): Streams the web build's background packs: the boot pack is the engine's own `.pck`, and the others land later under `user://packs/`, each mounted with `ProjectSettings.load_resource_pack`
- [redact.gd](scripts.ops.md#scriptsopsredactgd) (`Redact`): Masks secrets and personal data in text bound for logs and the local ops files: bearer and basic credentials, key=value secrets, sk- keys, JWTs, long random tokens, e-mail addresses and every value registered with add_secret() (the live GMI key)
- [resume_guard.gd](scripts.ops.md#scriptsopsresume_guardgd) (`ResumeGuard`): Web only: tells the game when the browser tab is hidden or shown again (the page's visibilitychange event)
- [trace.gd](scripts.ops.md#scriptsopstracegd) (`Trace`): Request and trace ids
- [web_pack_stream.gd](scripts.ops.md#scriptsopsweb_pack_streamgd) (`WebPackStream`): Background-pack streaming policy for the split web build (ops layer)
- [web_support.gd](scripts.ops.md#scriptsopsweb_supportgd) (`WebSupport`): Platform glue for the web build

## [scripts/sim/](scripts.sim.md)

- [city_sim.gd](scripts.sim.md#scriptssimcity_simgd) (`CitySim`): Tile-based SimCity-style simulation: zoning + demand-driven growth, power/water/sewage networks with load shedding, service coverage, pollution/crime/land value/traffic maps, per-district budgets and taxes, city-wide ordinances, disasters, time speeds, save/load
- [residents.gd](scripts.sim.md#scriptssimresidentsgd) (`Residents`): The people of GridFall: up to 100 named residents, each standing in for an equal share of the population
- [save_shape.gd](scripts.sim.md#scriptssimsave_shapegd): The shape a save must have before a load replaces the live city with it
- [sim_defs.gd](scripts.sim.md#scriptssimsim_defsgd) (`SimDefs`): Static rules, costs, and catalogs for the GridFall city simulation
- [spread_drain.gd](scripts.sim.md#scriptssimspread_draingd) (`SpreadDrain`): Drain scheduler for the day-start work the sliced sim spreads over frames: the brain's day round (five mayors and the support roles) and the residents' plan batches each run ONE piece per frame (CityBrain._process, ResidentMinds._run_spread), about fifty frames, while the sliced job waits for them (CitySim.spread_pending) and the clock sits at dawn

## [scripts/ui/](scripts.ui.md)

- [arena_text.gd](scripts.ui.md#scriptsuiarena_textgd): The orbit view's Arena tab as BBCode text: a block per mayor (health light, the person's name with the model as the sub-line, turns by where the answer came from, time to answer, accepted orders, repairs, tokens and a bar of what the mayor orders), then a line per service
- [city_hud.gd](scripts.ui.md#scriptsuicity_hudgd) (`CityHud`): SimCity-style HUD for GridFall: city vitals and RCI demand, time controls, player powers (overlays, disasters, decrees, grants, ordinance overrides), the five AI mayor cards, and panels for mayor minds, the Gazette, City Hall, the street inspector, the GMI call log and the city feed
- [council_board.gd](scripts.ui.md#scriptsuicouncil_boardgd): The City Hall tab's vote board (orbit): each proposal on the floor as a five-seat row (mayor colour, Y / N / - for how that mayor voted, a star on the proposer's seat) with the tally and, for one the Speaker already looked at, what it did; then the record of the last rulings with a loud OVERRIDE where the Speaker went against the count; then the notes and requests the mayors left each other (only when a live model wrote some)
- [gridfall_hud.gd](scripts.ui.md#scriptsuigridfall_hudgd) (`GridFallHud`): SimCity-Style Civic & Multi-Agent Growth HUD for GridFall: - Top Civic Bar: City Day/Phase, Population, 5 SimCity Vital Bars (⚡ Power, 🚰 Sewage/Water, 🚗 Traffic, 🌿 Sanitation, 😊 Happiness), Playback controls, HY-Image 3.5 Lookbook button, and ACE-Step 1.5 status
- [pack_status.gd](scripts.ui.md#scriptsuipack_statusgd) (`PackStatus`): Compact background-pack status line shared by the orbit and first-person HUDs

## [scripts/world/](scripts.world.md)

- [camera_controller.gd](scripts.world.md#scriptsworldcamera_controllergd) (`GridFallCamera`): Isometric camera rig for GridFall: WASD pan, mouse wheel zoom, drag pan, middle/right rotate
- [city_life.gd](scripts.world.md#scriptsworldcity_lifegd) (`CityLife`): Moving city life layered on top of CityView: buses that stop at bus stops, delivery and garbage trucks, emergency crews dispatched to live disasters, boats on the river, and planes and helicopters
- [city_view.gd](scripts.world.md#scriptsworldcity_viewgd) (`CityView`): Renders the CitySim grid in 3D: Kenney roads picked by neighbor mask, zone lots and density-based buildings, Blender service models, fires and disaster VFX, data overlays, autonomous cars and pedestrians, AI mayor avatars, and GMI speech bubbles
- [construction_kit.gd](scripts.world.md#scriptsworldconstruction_kitgd) (`ConstructionKit`): Procedural construction sites and machines: staged ground works, rising concrete frames, scaffolding, and animated excavators, backhoe loaders, dump trucks, cement mixers, tower cranes, bulldozers and road rollers
- [gridfall_world.gd](scripts.world.md#scriptsworldgridfall_worldgd) (`GridFallWorld`): Living SimCity-style 3D establishment for GridFall: - 19x19 city grid + 3-tile forested border with real Kenney asphalt roads, intersections, streetlights, fountains, parks, and intersection planters
- [orbit_tree_lod.gd](scripts.world.md#scriptsworldorbit_tree_lodgd) (`OrbitTreeLod`): The Planner's tree level of detail, decided per LOD cell and not per culling chunk
- [resident_avatars.gd](scripts.world.md#scriptsworldresident_avatarsgd) (`ResidentAvatars`): Draws every AI resident as the person (or car) actually making their trip: they walk or drive the road route their mind chose, go inside at home/work/shops, gather around incidents they are fixing, and speak their lines
- [shore.gd](scripts.world.md#scriptsworldshoregd): The shore band (CityView, on foot): sand and wet mud along every bank, with no new texture and no finer mesh
- [shore_rocks.gd](scripts.world.md#scriptsworldshore_rocksgd) (`ShoreRocks`): Cobbles and boulders along the river banks (materials unit G2)
- [sky_director.gd](scripts.world.md#scriptsworldsky_directorgd) (`SkyDirector`): Day/night cycle tied to the sim clock: tick 0 is morning, 3 is night
- [surface_materials.gd](scripts.world.md#scriptsworldsurface_materialsgd) (`SurfaceMaterials`): The street-level paved surfaces besides the carriageway (materials unit G2): pavement slabs, kerb stone, poured concrete and lane paint are all shaders/road_fp.gdshader with a different `surface` value, so the browser links one program set for every paved surface (a new shader costs boot time) and no mesh needs an instance uniform (Compatibility has 4096 slots for those)
- [water_surface.gd](scripts.world.md#scriptsworldwater_surfacegd): The water surface mesh and the hero's ripples, kept out of CityView (a file near its line cap)
